## POST `/api/2.58/realms/members`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

The creation of a `stretched realm`. When a `realm` is stretched to an `array`, the `data` in the `arrays` over which the `realm` is stretched is synchronously replicated. The `member_names` or `member_ids` parameter represents the `array` over which the `realm` is to be stretched. Both `realm` and `member` must be specified by `name` or `ID`.

| `realm_ids` | query | array of string |  | The comma-separated list of `realm` `IDs`. |

## DELETE `/api/2.58/realms/members`

**Tier:** T3  

The deletion of a `stretched realm` from an `array`, collapsing the `realm` to a `member array`. Unstretch a `realm` from an `array` when the `data` within the `stretched realm` no longer needs to be synchronously replicated between the two `members`. After a `realm` has been unstretched, synchronous replication stops. A `destroyed` version of the `realm` with `restretch` appended to the `realm name` is created on the `member` that no longer has the `realm`. The `restretched realm` represents a point-in-time `snapshot` of the `realm`, just before it was unstretched. The `restretched realm`…
